description: Ask the Handy AI answer desk a question about AI news, model releases, companies or research and get a short, sourced answer (50 to 150 words plus source links). It answers from the handyai.news archive first and the live web second, so it covers things newer than the archive. Rate limited: each connection (IP) gets 5 questions a day, shared with ask_handy_ai_report, plus a site-wide daily cap. Use search_articles or get_article when you only need what Handy AI wrote.

question.description: The question, in plain words. AI news, model releases, companies, research, or anything Handy AI has covered.

name: ask_handy_ai
title: Ask Handy AI
